## Convention divergences

1. **Migration tooling.** The repo generates migrations with drizzle-kit (`make db-generate` / `make migrate`, `Makefile:10-14`; architecture-map §Conventions «Migrations»): drizzle naming (`0000_<name>.sql`) + `meta/_journal.json`, no down migrations. The course default is SQL-first, timestamp-named `.up.sql` / `.down.sql`. Decision (user, this run): keep the staged SQL pairs as the reviewed contract; at promote-time write the Drizzle schema to match, generate with `make db-generate`, diff the generated SQL against the staged `.up.sql`; `.down.sql` remains the manual rollback. `drizzle-kit migrate` will not run `.down.sql` and will not pick up a hand-placed `.up.sql`.
2. **Composite natural PKs** on `half_moves (game_id, number)` and `game_commands (game_id, command_id)` instead of a UUID v7 `id` (user decision): pure logs, never referenced by their own id.
3. **`player_active_games.player_id` as PK** — the id comes from the player snapshot, not generated by this context.
4. **No `updated_at` on `games`** although the row is mutable — `version` + `finished_at` + `half_moves` cover the needs; PRD does not ask for a last-changed time. Surfaced in data-model.md.
5. **Partial index predicate `WHERE status = 'active'`** on `idx_games_active_turn_started_at` puts one app-enum literal into the DB; it is an index predicate, not a CHECK / DEFAULT.

## Drift findings

**Schema-vs-source:** skipped — `apps/server/src/game/domain/` holds only `.gitkeep`; no `_drift/*.sql` proposals.

**Model-vs-spec:**
- sad.md has **no §6.4 ER section** — the skill's expected ER stub is absent. Relationships were taken from ADR-0003 (c) («column lists in sad.md are illustrations … the final model is produced by generate-data-model»), ADR-0006, ADR-0007 and the `persists …` notes in §6. Suggest adding a one-line §6.4 pointer to data-model.md at the next SAD edit.
- sad.md §5 C4 Container describes the DB as «Games and the half-move log»; the model adds `player_active_games`, `game_commands`, `rematch_offers`. Consistent with ADRs, just more detailed — optional wording update.
- Every PRD / SAD persisted concept has a table or column: game, half-move, clocks, draw offer (+ AC-15 block), game end / abort, rematch offer, player snapshot, `commandId`. Not persisted by decision: presence (ADR-0007), integration events (ADR-0006).
- No orphan tables: `player_active_games` ← ADR-0007 (a); `game_commands` ← ADR-0003 (`commandId`); `rematch_offers` ← sad.md §6 «rematch offer closed timestamp».

## Self-check (4/4 pass)

- **Naming:** plural snake_case tables; all 10 files match `<14-digit timestamp>_create_<table>.{up,down}.sql`.
- **down.sql reversibility:** every `CREATE TABLE` / `CREATE INDEX` has a matching `DROP`; indexes dropped before their table.
- **FK indexes:** 5 FKs, each covered by an index with the FK column leading — `uq_games_previous_game_id`, `idx_player_active_games_game_id`, `half_moves_pkey`, `game_commands_pkey`, and `uq_rematch_offers_open_game_id` (partial, `WHERE closed_at IS NULL` — closed offers are never queried and games are never deleted, so no full index).
- **Forbidden features:** no `CHECK (`, `CREATE TRIGGER`, business `DEFAULT '…'`, sequences, `updated_at`, `deleted_at`.

ER diagram: no Mermaid renderer available (`mmdc` absent, no `mermaid` package) — structural lint passed (fences, cardinality glyphs, all 5 entities declared, attribute lines `type name [PK|FK|UK]`). A real parse is recommended when `mmdc` is installed.
